sloka: लक्ष्मणो लक्ष्मि संपन्नो बहिः प्राण इव अपरः ।न च तेन विना निद्राम् लभते पुरुषोत्तमः ॥१-१८-३०॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇo lakṣmi saṁpanno bahiḥ prāṇa iva aparaḥ ।na ca tena vinā nidrām labhate puruṣottamaḥ ॥1-18-30॥

translations.english: Whenever Raghava (Rama) went hunting into the forest, riding the horse, Lakshmana used to follow him holding bow and arrows (in his hand).
